verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਸਚ ਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh melaa sach dhaa sach milai sachiaar sa(n)jogee|

en.bdb: Gurmukh longs for the glimpse of truth and the truth is abtained only by providentially meeting an adopter of the truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਬਾਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: gharabaaree paravaar vich bhog bhugat raaje ras bhogee|

en.bdb: Living in the family, the gurmukh like a dutiful householder enjoys all materials and like kings tastes all delights.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਹੁਇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੀਸਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: aasaa vich niraas hui jog jugat jogeesar jogee|

en.bdb: He remains detached amidst all hopes and, knowing the technique of yoga, is known as the king of yogis.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਜੋਗ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: dhe(n)dhaa rahai na ma(n)geeaai marai na hoi vijog vijogee|

en.bdb: He always bestows and begs nothing. Neither he dies nor he suffers the pangs of the separation from the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਹੈ ਵਾਇ ਪਿਤ ਕਫੁ ਰੋਗ ਅਰੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: aadh biaadh upaadh hai vai pit kaf rog arogee|

en.bdb: He is not troubled by pains and maladies and he remains free from the diseases of air, cough and heat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਅਪਦਾ ਸੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: dhukh sukh samasar gurmatee sa(n)pai harakh na apadhaa sogee|

en.bdb: He accepts sufferings and joys alike; wisdom of the Guru is his wealth and he is uninfluenced by joy and sorrows.
Being embodied he is yet beyond the body and while living in the world he is beyond the world.
